serverUrl.title: Answer server address
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the attestq server (attestq serve), e.g. https://attestq.example.internal

apiToken.title: Access token
apiToken.description: Bearer token the server requires (attestq serve --token). Leave unset if the server has none.

defaultNamespace.title: Default vendor
defaultNamespace.description: Namespace preselected in the vendor picker.

appendSources.title: Append source names
appendSources.description: Add the evidence document names to each drafted explanation.
